acceptance_criteria.summary: Documented and tested agent capture for idea, journal, URL resource, and structured knowledge item through save_memory and inbox search.
Documented and tested inbox review with search(capture_status="inbox") and set_capture_status transitions that preserve lifecycle status unless explicitly changed.
Added DailyReview/generate_daily_review, source extraction, daily_review MCP tool, ob daily CLI command, documentation, and fixture-backed integration evidence.
Extended existing weekly briefing with canonical_entities and inbox_state fields, plus canonical entity select predicate reuse and fixture-backed integration evidence.

advisory_fixes.summary: Removed the dead Memory.session_ref getattr fallback from _extract_source; session_ref source extraction now only reads metadata["session_ref"].

advisory_fixes.summary: Widened SearchParams.metadata_filter to dict[str, str | bool] | None so the canonical_entity boolean marker is type-correct without changing postgres search matching.

regression_fixes.summary: ob daily default date now resolves from local time (datetime.now().astimezone().date()) instead of datetime.now(tz=UTC).date(); around local midnight the no-argument CLI reviewed the wrong day. Removed the now-unused UTC import from cli/main.py. generate_daily_review already handles the tz day-boundary math; no new --tz flag or MCP parameter added.

_inbox_state now reports the true backlog size from SearchResult.total for the 'pending' field (threaded via inbox_result.total) instead of len(memories) from the capped result list; the sample preview still uses the capped list. Backlogs above max_memories (default 200) previously under-reported pending capped at 200.
